ValidationRule.description: Avoidable Escalation Reason field is required if Avoidable Escalation? field is checked
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint'), IDR_Avoidable_Escalation__c = true, ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Avoidable_Escalation_Reason__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Avoidable Escalation Reason is required if 'Avoidable Escalation?' field is ticked.
